text.about.2: It started as a weekend hobby and became the work I love most.
text.about.3: Five years ago I began helping a friend edit his YouTube uploads. I fell in love with storytelling through design, logo work and color grading, and turned it into a full-time career.

services.title: Poster Design
services.desc: Eye-catching posters for businesses, promotions, events, ads and social media campaigns, tailored to your brand.

services.title: Logo Design
services.desc: Unique, modern logos that build a strong brand identity and make your business stand out.

services.title: Menu Design
services.desc: Well-organized restaurant, café and fast-food menus that showcase your products professionally.

services.title: Packaging Design
services.desc: Premium packaging for boxes, labels, wrappers and custom packaging solutions.

services.title: Brochure Design
services.desc: Visually appealing brochures for business promotions, company profiles, catalogs and campaigns.

services.title: Visiting Card Design
services.desc: Elegant business cards that make a strong first impression and represent your brand.

services.title: Unlimited Graphic Design Subscription
services.desc: Get unlimited design requests for one fixed monthly payment. Enjoy consistent, high-quality designs for all your business and marketing needs without paying separately for every design.
services.features:
Fixed monthly payment: one agreed price per month.
Unlimited designs: request as many as you need.
All categories included: posters, logos, menus, packaging, brochures, visiting cards and more.
Professional quality: creative, premium, brand-focused work.
Unlimited revisions: adjustments until you are satisfied.
No per-design charges: one payment covers every request.

awards.title: Best Graphic Designer Award
awards.org: Local business and creative design community
awards.desc: Recognizes outstanding creativity, professional design skills and strong visual communication, the qualities clients rely on when they hire me.

awards.title: Featured Designer
awards.org: A popular graphic design platform or creative community
awards.desc: Featured for consistently delivering high-quality designs and creative branding solutions, proof that the work holds up in front of fellow designers.

awards.title: Guest Speaker
awards.desc: Invited to talk about graphic design as a career, creative branding and why visual communication matters, and to share what I have learned with students.

awards.title: Brand Identity Specialist
awards.desc: Recognized for unique, professional brand identities, from logos and business cards to packaging and marketing materials.

awards.title: Creative Design Excellence
awards.desc: Appreciated for outstanding posters, restaurant menus, brochures, packaging designs and promotional graphics.

projects.title: Night Market
projects.short: Event poster with layered type and a neon palette.
projects.desc: Designed the full poster system for a three-night street food festival: a bold type-led main poster plus social and print variations.

projects.title: Skyline Sessions
projects.short: Concert poster built around a bold illustrated skyline.
projects.desc: Created the key art and layout for a live music series, balancing illustration and readable lineup details.

projects.title: Lumen Coffee
projects.short: Wordmark and symbol for a specialty coffee roaster.
projects.desc: Developed the logo, color palette and usage rules, delivered as a compact brand sheet.

projects.title: Northwind
projects.short: Minimal monogram logo for an outdoor apparel label.
projects.desc: Explored a dozen directions with the client, then refined one monogram into a flexible mark.

projects.title: Coastal Reel
projects.short: Cinematic grade and title design for a travel short.
projects.desc: Graded the footage for a warm teal and orange look and designed matching title cards.

projects.title: Frame One
projects.short: Moody grade and cover art for a documentary teaser.
projects.desc: Built a consistent grade across scenes and designed the teaser cover to match.

projects.title: Atlas Studio
projects.short: Tri-fold brochure for an architecture studio.
projects.desc: Laid out the copy and photography into a clean tri-fold with a strong grid and generous white space.

projects.title: Harbor Bank
projects.short: Product brochure that makes finance feel clear.
projects.desc: Turned dense product details into scannable spreads with icons and simple data visuals.

projects.title: Kiln & Co. Menu
projects.short: Dinner menu for a wood-fired kitchen.
projects.desc: Designed a one-page menu with clear hierarchy, so guests find dishes fast.

projects.title: Saffron House
projects.short: Illustrated menu for a family restaurant.
projects.desc: Combined hand-drawn details with a tidy layout for both dine-in and takeaway menus.

projects.title: Fable Tea
projects.short: Box and label system for a premium tea range.
projects.desc: Designed a color-coded box and label set, from dieline artwork to final print files.

projects.title: Orbit Snacks
projects.short: Bright snack pouch with a bold flavor system.
projects.desc: Created the pouch artwork and flavor-coding system that makes each product recognizable on shelf.
